ov: زهايمر هو فيلم كوميدي اجتماعي مصري أصدر سنة 2010م، من بطولة عادل إمام ونيللي كريم ومن إخراج عمرو عرفة وتأليف نادر صلاح الدين.
plotEn: Mahmoud (played by Emam) realizes one morning that he cannot recognize the people who work at his home, including his nurse Mona (Nelly Karim).  However, he has actually been deceived by his children to believe that he has Alzheimer's disease, so they can get control of his wealth to pay off their own debts.
